  <script>
    (() => {
      'use strict';

      const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });

      // Deterministic PRNG for consistent organic craft
      function mulberry32(seed) {
        let a = seed >>> 0;
        return function () {
          a |= 0;
          a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
          let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
          t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
          return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
        };
      }

      // Smooth 1D value noise for organic shapes and flicker
      const perm = new Uint8Array(512);
      {
        const rng = mulberry32(4219);
        const p = new Uint8Array(256);
        for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) p[i] = i;
        for (let i = 255; i > 0; i--) {
          const j = Math.floor(rng() * (i + 1));
          const tmp = p[i];
          p[i] = p[j];
          p[j] = tmp;
        }
        for (let i = 0; i < 512; i++) perm[i] = p[i & 255];
      }

      function fade(t) {
        return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6 - 15) + 10);
      }

      function lerp(a, b, t) {
        return a + (b - a) * t;
      }

      function noise1D(x) {
        const xi = Math.floor(x) & 255;
        const xf = x - Math.floor(x);
        const u = fade(xf);
        const a = perm[xi] / 255;
        const b = perm[xi + 1] / 255;
        return lerp(a, b, u) * 2 - 1;
      }

      // Reduced motion handling
      const motionQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
      let reducedMotion = motionQuery.matches;

      // Viewport & geometry state
      let width = 0;
      let height = 0;
      let dpr = 1;
      let bowlR = 200;
      let bowlCx = 0;
      let bowlCy = 0;
      const TILT = 0.79; // 3/4 overhead elliptical ratio

      // Interactive pointer state
      const pointer = {
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
        nx: 0, // normalized -1..1
        ny: 0,
        sx: 0, // smoothed normalized
        sy: 0,
        vx: 0,
        vy: 0,
        active: false,
        lastRippleTime: 0
      };

      // Dynamic simulation state
      const ripples = [];
      const steamPuffs = [];
      const steamRibbons = [];
      const dustMotes = [];
      let oilDroplets = [];
      let scallions = [];
      let sesameSeeds = [];
      let cornKernels = [];
      let noodleStrands = [];
      let rimWobble = [];

      // Offscreen procedural textures
      let woodCanvas = null;
      let stoneCanvas = null;
      let steamSprite = null;
      let warmSteamSprite = null;
      let noriCanvas = null;

      function createOffscreen(w, h) {
        const c = document.createElement('canvas');
        c.width = w;
        c.height = h;
        return c;
      }

      // Generate charred cedar (yakisugi) wood surface texture
      function buildWoodTexture() {
        const w = 512;
        const h = 512;
        const c = createOffscreen(w, h);
        const g = c.getContext('2d');
        const rng = mulberry32(9011);

        g.fillStyle = '#0d0907';
        g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

        // Horizontal wood grain bands
        for (let y = 0; y < h; y += 2) {
          const wave = Math.sin(y * 0.035) * 0.5 + Math.sin(y * 0.11 + 1.3) * 0.3 + noise1D(y * 0.08) * 0.4;
          const lum = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 0.5 + wave * 0.35));
          const r = Math.round(13 + lum * 15);
          const gr = Math.round(9 + lum * 10);
          const b = Math.round(7 + lum * 7);
          g.fillStyle = `rgb(${r},${gr},${b})`;
          g.fillRect(0, y, w, 2);
        }

        // Subtle charred fiber streaks
        for (let i = 0; i < 420; i++) {
          const y = rng() * h;
          const x = rng() * w;
          const len = 40 + rng() * 220;
          const dark = rng() > 0.35;
          g.strokeStyle = dark
            ? `rgba(4, 2, 1, ${0.15 + rng() * 0.25})`
            : `rgba(58, 38, 24, ${0.05 + rng() * 0.09})`;
          g.lineWidth = 0.6 + rng() * 1.8;
          g.beginPath();
          g.moveTo(x, y);
          g.bezierCurveTo(
            x + len * 0.33, y + (rng() - 0.5) * 4,
            x + len * 0.66, y + (rng() - 0.5) * 4,
            x + len, y + (rng() - 0.5) * 3
          );
          g.stroke();
        }

        // Subtle plank seam
        g.fillStyle = 'rgba(2, 1, 1, 0.45)';
        g.fillRect(0, h * 0.5, w, 2);
        g.fillStyle = 'rgba(65, 42, 26, 0.07)';
        g.fillRect(0, h * 0.5 + 2, w, 1);

        woodCanvas = c;
      }

      // Generate stoneware ceramic speckle texture
      function buildStonewareTexture() {
        const s = 256;
        const c = createOffscreen(s, s);
        const g = c.getContext('2d');
        const rng = mulberry32(3317);

        g.clearRect(0, 0, s, s);
        for (let i = 0; i < 1600; i++) {
          const x = rng() * s;
          const y = rng() * s;
          const rad = 0.4 + rng() * 1.3;
          const warm = rng() > 0.55;
          g.fillStyle = warm
            ? `rgba(175, 130, 92, ${0.04 + rng() * 0.11})`
            : `rgba(8, 6, 5, ${0.08 + rng() * 0.16})`;
          g.beginPath();
          g.arc(x, y, rad, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          g.fill();
        }
        stoneCanvas = c;
      }

      // Generate soft organic cloud puff sprites for volumetric steam
      function buildSteamSprites() {
        function makePuff(r, gCol, bCol, seed) {
          const s = 160;
          const c = createOffscreen(s, s);
          const g = c.getContext('2d');
          const rng = mulberry32(seed);
          const cx = s * 0.5;
          const cy = s * 0.5;

          // Layer overlapping soft radial lobes so it looks organic, not geometric
          for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            const ang = (i / 6) * Math.PI * 2 + rng() * 0.6;
            const dist = i === 0 ? 0 : (10 + rng() * 18);
            const px = cx + Math.cos(ang) * dist;
            const py = cy + Math.sin(ang) * dist * 0.85;
            const rad = i === 0 ? s * 0.42 : s * (0.24 + rng() * 0.14);
            const grad = g.createRadialGradient(px, py, 0, px, py, rad);
            grad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${r}, ${gCol}, ${bCol}, 0.22)`);
            grad.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(${r}, ${gCol}, ${bCol}, 0.09)`);
            grad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${r}, ${gCol}, ${bCol}, 0)`);
            g.fillStyle = grad;
            g.beginPath();
            g.arc(px, py, rad, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            g.fill();
          }
          return c;
        }

        steamSprite = makePuff(238, 228, 214, 7721);
        warmSteamSprite = makePuff(255, 206, 152, 8831);
      }

      // Generate fibrous roasted nori texture
      function buildNoriTexture() {
        const w = 128;
        const h = 160;
        const c = createOffscreen(w, h);
        const g = c.getContext('2d');
        const rng = mulberry32(5501);

        g.fillStyle = '#0f1c14';
        g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

        // Crisscrossing dark seaweed fibers
        for (let i = 0; i < 380; i++) {
          const x = rng() * w;
          const y = rng() * h;
          const ang = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
          const len = 8 + rng() * 24;
          g.strokeStyle = rng() > 0.4
            ? `rgba(34, 58, 38, ${0.18 + rng() * 0.22})`
            : `rgba(5, 10, 7, ${0.25 + rng() * 0.3})`;
          g.lineWidth = 0.7 + rng() * 1.4;
          g.beginPath();
          g.moveTo(x, y);
          g.lineTo(x + Math.cos(ang) * len, y + Math.sin(ang) * len);
          g.stroke();
        }
        // Subtle toasted sheen specks
        for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++) {
          g.fillStyle = `rgba(110, 145, 92, ${0.06 + rng() * 0.08})`;
          g.fillRect(rng() * w, rng() * h, 1.5, 1.5);
        }
        noriCanvas = c;
      }

      // Initialize procedural ingredients (normalized to bowl radius = 1)
      function initSceneData() {
        const rng = mulberry32(2026);

        // Subtle handmade ceramic rim wobble
        rimWobble = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
          const a = (i / 64) * Math.PI * 2;
          const w = Math.sin(a * 3 + 0.5) * 0.0045 + Math.cos(a * 5 - 1.1) * 0.0028 + Math.sin(a * 7) * 0.0015;
          rimWobble.push(w);
        }

        // Submerged & emerging wavy ramen noodles
        noodleStrands = [];
        // Deep submerged strands
        for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
          const baseAngle = -0.35 + (rng() - 0.5) * 1.1;
          const offset = (i / 24 - 0.5) * 1.18 + (rng() - 0.5) * 0.08;
          noodleStrands.push({
            layer: 0,
            offset,
            angle: baseAngle,
            amp: 0.032 + rng() * 0.025,
            freq: 6.5 + rng() * 4.5,
            phase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
            width: 0.026 + rng() * 0.01,
            tone: rng(),
            len: 0.65 + rng() * 0.35
          });
        }
        // Emerging glistening noodle fold (center-right / lower-center)
        for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
          const t = i / 15;
          noodleStrands.push({
            layer: 1,
            t,
            amp: 0.024 + rng() * 0.014,
            freq: 8.5 + rng() * 3.0,
            phase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
            width: 0.028 + rng() * 0.008,
            tone: rng()
          });
        }

        // Sweet golden corn kernels (clustered pocket at lower-right: ~4:30-6 o'clock)
        cornKernels = [];
        const cornCenterX = 0.27;
        const cornCenterY = 0.35;
        for (let i = 0; i < 38; i++) {
          const r = Math.sqrt(rng()) * 0.21;
          const a = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
          const x = cornCenterX + Math.cos(a) * r * 1.15;
          const y = cornCenterY + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.82;
          cornKernels.push({
            x,
            y,
            rx: 0.038 + rng() * 0.012,
            ry: 0.029 + rng() * 0.01,
            rot: rng() * Math.PI,
            hueShift: (rng() - 0.5) * 14,
            bobPhase: rng() * Math.PI * 2
          });
        }
        cornKernels.sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y);

        // Floating scallions (negi rings)
        scallions = [];
        const scallionSpots = [
          [0.02, -0.02], [-0.08, 0.07], [0.11, 0.05], [-0.03, 0.16],
          [0.09, -0.11], [-0.15, -0.06], [0.18, 0.13], [0.04, 0.26],
          [-0.12, 0.24], [0.22, -0.04], [-0.04, -0.17], [0.15, 0.22],
          [-0.22, 0.08], [0.01, 0.09], [0.26, 0.07], [-0.09, -0.22],
          [0.14, -0.19], [-0.18, 0.31]
        ];
        for (const [sx, sy] of scallionSpots) {
          scallions.push({
            bx: sx,
            by: sy,
            x: sx,
            y: sy,
            vx: 0,
            vy: 0,
            r: 0.036 + rng() * 0.018,
            tilt: 0.62 + rng() * 0.28,
            rot: rng() * Math.PI,
            isPale: rng() > 0.68,
            bobPhase: rng() * Math.PI * 2
          });
        }

        // Floating chili oil (rayu) & golden sesame oil droplets
        oilDroplets = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < 68; i++) {
          const rad = Math.sqrt(rng()) * 0.78;
          const ang = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
          const x = Math.cos(ang) * rad;
          const y = Math.sin(ang) * rad;
          const isChili = rng() < 0.58;
          const size = rng() < 0.16
            ? 0.024 + rng() * 0.024
            : 0.007 + rng() * 0.014;
          oilDroplets.push({
            bx: x,
            by: y,
            x,
            y,
            vx: 0,
            vy: 0,
            r: size,
            isChili,
            driftPhase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
            driftSpeed: 0.25 + rng() * 0.35
          });
        }

        // Toasted white & black sesame seeds
        sesameSeeds = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < 54; i++) {
          const rad = Math.sqrt(rng()) * 0.74;
          const ang = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
          sesameSeeds.push({
            x: Math.cos(ang) * rad,
            y: Math.sin(ang) * rad,
            rot: rng() * Math.PI,
            dark: rng() < 0.34,
            bobPhase: rng() * Math.PI * 2
          });
        }

        // Volumetric steam puffs
        steamPuffs.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 52; i++) {
          steamPuffs.push(createSteamPuff(rng, true));
        }

        // Curling wispy steam ribbons
        steamRibbons.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
          steamRibbons.push({
            anchorX: (i / 8 - 0.5) * 1.05 + (rng() - 0.5) * 0.12,
            anchorY: (rng() - 0.5) * 0.38,
            phase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
            speed: 0.42 + rng() * 0.32,
            amp: 0.12 + rng() * 0.12,
            freq: 2.2 + rng() * 1.4,
            heightScale: 1.05 + rng() * 0.65,
            widthScale: 0.14 + rng() * 0.12,
            alpha: 0.055 + rng() * 0.045,
            swayOffset: 0,
            swayVel: 0
          });
        }

        // Warm ambient dust motes
        dustMotes.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
          dustMotes.push({
            x: rng(),
            y: rng(),
            r: 0.8 + rng() * 1.8,
            speedY: -0.004 - rng() * 0.008,
            driftPhase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
            alpha: 0.06 + rng() * 0.16
          });
        }
      }

      function createSteamPuff(rng, randomAge) {
        const ang = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
        const rad = Math.sqrt(rng()) * 0.58;
        const life = randomAge ? rng() : 0;
        return {
          x: Math.cos(ang) * rad,
          y: Math.sin(ang) * rad * TILT - 0.05,
          vx: (rng() - 0.5) * 0.04,
          vy: -(0.22 + rng() * 0.18),
          life,
          maxLife: 3.4 + rng() * 2.8,
          age: life * (3.4 + rng() * 2.8),
          size: 0.24 + rng() * 0.26,
          rot: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
          rotSpeed: (rng() - 0.5) * 0.35,
          turbulencePhase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
          warmth: 0.4 + rng() * 0.6
        };
      }

      function spawnRipple(nx, ny, strength) {
        if (ripples.length > 10) ripples.shift();
        ripples.push({
          x: nx,
          y: ny,
          r: 0.02,
          maxR: 0.32 + strength * 0.24,
          alpha: 0.32 * strength
        });
      }

      // Resize handler
      function resize() {
        dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
        width = window.innerWidth;
        height = window.innerHeight;
        canvas.width = Math.round(width * dpr);
        canvas.height = Math.round(height * dpr);
        ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

        const minDim = Math.min(width, height);
        const aspect = width / Math.max(1, height);
        // Generous upper headroom for rising steam on all aspect ratios
        bowlR = aspect < 0.85
          ? Math.min(width * 0.41, height * 0.28)
          : Math.min(minDim * 0.355, width * 0.33);
        bowlCx = width * 0.5;
        bowlCy = height * (aspect < 0.85 ? 0.60 : 0.58);

        if (reducedMotion) {
          render(4.2, 0);
        }
      }

      // Pointer interactivity
      function updatePointer(clientX, clientY, isDown) {
        if (reducedMotion) return;
        const prevX = pointer.x;
        const prevY = pointer.y;
        pointer.x = clientX;
        pointer.y = clientY;
        pointer.nx = (clientX / Math.max(1, width)) * 2 - 1;
        pointer.ny = (clientY / Math.max(1, height)) * 2 - 1;

        if (pointer.active) {
          pointer.vx = lerp(pointer.vx, (clientX - prevX) / Math.max(1, bowlR), 0.35);
          pointer.vy = lerp(pointer.vy, (clientY - prevY) / Math.max(1, bowlR), 0.35);
        }
        pointer.active = true;

        // Check if pointer is over broth interior for ripples & gentle nudge
        const bx = (clientX - bowlCx) / (bowlR * 0.88);
        const by = (clientY - (bowlCy + bowlR * 0.03)) / (bowlR * 0.88 * TILT);
        const distSq = bx * bx + by * by;
        const now = performance.now();

        if (distSq < 0.88) {
          if (isDown) {
            spawnRipple(bx, by, 1.0);
            nudgeSurfaceItems(bx, by, 0.08);
            pointer.lastRippleTime = now;
          } else if (now - pointer.lastRippleTime > 240 && (Math.abs(pointer.vx) + Math.abs(pointer.vy)) > 0.018) {
            spawnRipple(bx, by, 0.55);
            nudgeSurfaceItems(bx, by, 0.035);
            pointer.lastRippleTime = now;
          }
        }
      }

      function nudgeSurfaceItems(bx, by, force) {
        for (const sc of scallions) {
          const dx = sc.x - bx;
          const dy = sc.y - by;
          const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
          if (d < 0.32 && d > 0.001) {
            const push = (1 - d / 0.32) * force;
            sc.vx += (dx / d) * push;
            sc.vy += (dy / d) * push;
          }
        }
        for (const drop of oilDroplets) {
          const dx = drop.x - bx;
          const dy = drop.y - by;
          const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
          if (d < 0.28 && d > 0.001) {
            const push = (1 - d / 0.28) * force * 1.15;
            drop.vx += (dx / d) * push;
            drop.vy += (dy / d) * push;
          }
        }
      }

      window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => updatePointer(e.clientX, e.clientY, false), { passive: true });
      window.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => updatePointer(e.clientX, e.clientY, true), { passive: true });
      window.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => {
        pointer.nx = 0;
        pointer.ny = 0;
      });

      // =========================================================================
      // DRAWING LAYERS
      // =========================================================================

      function drawBackground(time, lightX, lightY, flicker) {
        // Tile dark charred wood texture subtly
        if (woodCanvas) {
          const pat = ctx.createPattern(woodCanvas, 'repeat');
          ctx.fillStyle = pat;
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
        } else {
          ctx.fillStyle = '#0d0907';
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
        }

        // Warm overhead lantern pool on table surface
        const poolX = bowlCx + lightX * bowlR * 0.42;
        const poolY = bowlCy + bowlR * 0.12 + lightY * bowlR * 0.25;
        const poolR = Math.max(width, height) * 0.68;
        const warmPool = ctx.createRadialGradient(poolX, poolY, bowlR * 0.2, poolX, poolY, poolR);
        warmPool.addColorStop(0, `rgba(176, 98, 42, ${0.22 * flicker})`);
        warmPool.addColorStop(0.32, `rgba(112, 56, 22, ${0.14 * flicker})`);
        warmPool.addColorStop(0.65, `rgba(38, 19, 10, ${0.12 * flicker})`);
        warmPool.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(6, 4, 3, 0.82)');
        ctx.fillStyle = warmPool;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

        // Atmospheric warm upper-back glow behind rising steam
        const steamGlowY = bowlCy - bowlR * 0.95;
        const steamGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          bowlCx + lightX * bowlR * 0.2,
          steamGlowY,
          bowlR * 0.05,
          bowlCx,
          steamGlowY,
          bowlR * 1.85
        );
        steamGlow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(210, 128, 62, ${0.095 * flicker})`);
        steamGlow.addColorStop(0.55, `rgba(120, 62, 26, ${0.04 * flicker})`);
        steamGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = steamGlow;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

        // Subtle dark vignette around screen edges
        const vig = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          bowlCx, bowlCy * 0.95, bowlR * 0.9,
          bowlCx, bowlCy * 0.95, Math.max(width, height) * 0.78
        );
        vig.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
        vig.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(5, 3, 2, 0.35)');
        vig.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(3, 2, 1, 0.85)');
        ctx.fillStyle = vig;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
      }

      function drawBowlShadow(cx, cy, R, lightX, lightY) {
        const sx = cx - lightX * R * 0.14;
        const sy = cy + R * 0.56 - lightY * R * 0.06;

        // Broad ambient cast shadow
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(sx, sy);
        ctx.scale(1.18, 0.72);
        const softSh = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, R * 0.32, 0, 0, R * 1.15);
        softSh.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.82)');
        softSh.addColorStop(0.52, 'rgba(3, 2, 1, 0.56)');
        softSh.addColorStop(0.82, 'rgba(5, 3, 2, 0.18)');
        softSh.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = softSh;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, 0, R * 1.15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();

        // Tight contact shadow directly under foot ring
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(cx - lightX * R * 0.04, cy + R * 0.69);
        ctx.scale(1, 0.58);
        const footSh = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, R * 0.15, 0, 0, R * 0.64);
        footSh.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.92)');
        footSh.addColorStop(0.65, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55)');
        footSh.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = footSh;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, 0, R * 0.64, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
      }

      function traceOrganicRim(cx, cy, rx, ry) {
        const n = rimWobble.length;
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
          const idx = i % n;
          const a = (idx / n) * Math.PI * 2;
          const w = 1 + rimWobble[idx];
          const x = cx + Math.cos(a) * rx * w;
          const y = cy + Math.sin(a) * ry * w;
          if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
          else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
        }
        ctx.closePath();
      }

      function drawBowlExterior(cx, cy, R, lightX, lightY, flicker) {
        const ry = R * TILT;

        // Ceramic bowl silhouette extending below the elliptical rim
        ctx.save();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(cx - R * 1.002, cy + R * 0.01);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(
          cx - R * 0.99, cy + R * 0.62,
          cx - R * 0.64, cy + R * 1.01,
          cx - R * 0.42, cy + R * 1.04
        );
        // Subtle foot ring curve
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx, cy + R * 1.11, cx + R * 0.42, cy + R * 1.04);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(
          cx + R * 0.64, cy + R * 1.01,
          cx + R * 0.99, cy + R * 0.62,
          cx + R * 1.002, cy + R * 0.01
        );
        ctx.closePath();

        // Rich dark artisan stoneware shading
        const lx = cx + lightX * R * 0.45 - R * 0.28;
        const ly = cy + R * 0.35 + lightY * R * 0.15;
        const bodyGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(lx, ly, R * 0.08, cx, cy + R * 0.42, R * 1.25);
        bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#3a2e26');
        bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.32, '#241c17');
        bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#14100e');
        bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#090706');
        ctx.fillStyle = bodyGrad;
        ctx.fill();

        // Clip to exterior to add wheel-thrown ridges, stoneware speckles, and warm bounce light
        ctx.clip();

        // Horizontal potter's wheel throw ribs
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 210, 170, 0.032)';
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, R * 0.006);
        for (let i = 1; i <= 7; i++) {
          const t = i / 8;
          const yPos = cy + R * (0.28 + t * 0.72);
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(cx, yPos - R * 0.4, R * (1.02 - t * 0.22), ry * 0.85, 0, 0.15, Math.PI - 0.15);
          ctx.stroke();
        }

        // Stoneware speckle texture overlay
        if (stoneCanvas) {
          ctx.globalAlpha = 0.65;
          ctx.fillStyle = ctx.createPattern(stoneCanvas, 'repeat');
          ctx.fillRect(cx - R * 1.1, cy - R * 0.2, R * 2.2, R * 1.4);
          ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        }

        // Subtle warm bounce light from table along lower belly
        const bounce = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          cx + lightX * R * 0.25, cy + R * 0.92, R * 0.05,
          cx, cy + R * 0.85, R * 0.85
        );
        bounce.addColorStop(0, `rgba(175, 102, 48, ${0.14 * flicker})`);
        bounce.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = bounce;
        ctx.fillRect(cx - R, cy, R * 2, R * 1.2);

        // Subtle dark terracotta glaze drip band near rim
        const glazeBand = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx, cy + ry * 0.55, cx, cy + ry * 1.18);
        glazeBand.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(110, 74, 48, 0.26)');
        glazeBand.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(65, 42, 28, 0.12)');
        glazeBand.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = glazeBand;
        ctx.fillRect(cx - R, cy + ry * 0.4, R * 2, ry * 0.8);

        ctx.restore();

        // Rim outer bezel & inner ceramic wall
        ctx.save();
        traceOrganicRim(cx, cy, R, ry);
        const rimGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(
          cx - R + lightX * R * 0.4, cy - ry + lightY * R * 0.3,
          cx + R, cy + ry
        );
        rimGrad.addColorStop(0, '#6c523e');
        rimGrad.addColorStop(0.28, '#3b2c22');
        rimGrad.addColorStop(0.65, '#1d1612');
        rimGrad.addColorStop(0.88, '#4e392a');
        rimGrad.addColorStop(1, '#261d17');
        ctx.fillStyle = rimGrad;
        ctx.fill();

        // Inner ceramic bowl wall (visible dark crescent above broth)
        traceOrganicRim(cx, cy + R * 0.008, R * 0.942, ry * 0.935);
        const innerWallGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          cx, cy + R * 0.12, R * 0.2,
          cx, cy - R * 0.18, R * 0.98
        );
        innerWallGrad.addColorStop(0, '#140f0c');
        innerWallGrad.addColorStop(0.62, '#1f1713');
        innerWallGrad.addColorStop(0.88, '#33251d');
        innerWallGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1a130f');
        ctx.fillStyle = innerWallGrad;
        ctx.fill();

        // Warm reflected glow from broth onto inner back ceramic wall
        ctx.clip();
        const wallBounce = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          cx, cy - ry * 0.15, R * 0.1,
          cx, cy - ry * 0.55, R * 0.95
        );
        wallBounce.addColorStop(0, `rgba(215, 128, 46, ${0.18 * flicker})`);
        wallBounce.addColorStop(0.65, `rgba(145, 74, 24, ${0.09 * flicker})`);
        wallBounce.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = wallBounce;
        ctx.fillRect(cx - R, cy - ry, R * 2, ry * 2);
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // Draw crisp ceramic rim specular catchlight on top of everything inside the rim
      function drawBowlRimHighlight(cx, cy, R, lightX, lightY, flicker) {
        const ry = R * TILT;

      }

      // Draw roasted nori sheets tucked upright into back-left of bowl
      function drawNoriSheets(cx, cy, R, time, lightX) {
        const sheets = [
          { x: -0.54, y: -0.44, w: 0.33, h: 0.43, rot: -0.36, swayPhase: 0.2 },
          { x: -0.34, y: -0.56, w: 0.34, h: 0.45, rot: -0.14, swayPhase: 1.9 }
        ];

        for (let i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
          const s = sheets[i];
          const sway = Math.sin(time * 1.15 + s.swayPhase) * 0.012;
          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(cx + s.x * R, cy + s.y * R * TILT);
          ctx.rotate(s.rot + sway);

          const w = s.w * R;
          const h = s.h * R;

          // Soft shadow cast on bowl wall / behind
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42)';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(-w * 0.48 + 4, -h * 0.55 + 4);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -h * 0.58 + 4, w * 0.48 + 4, -h * 0.52 + 4);
          ctx.lineTo(w * 0.45 + 4, h * 0.48);
          ctx.lineTo(-w * 0.46 + 4, h * 0.48);
          ctx.closePath();
          ctx.fill();

          // Slightly curled crisp seaweed silhouette
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(-w * 0.5, -h * 0.58);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -h * 0.62, w * 0.5, -h * 0.54);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(w * 0.53, 0, w * 0.46, h * 0.48);
          ctx.lineTo(-w * 0.46, h * 0.48);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-w * 0.52, -h * 0.05, -w * 0.5, -h * 0.58);
          ctx.closePath();

          const noriGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-w * 0.5, -h * 0.6, w * 0.5, h * 0.4);
          noriGrad.addColorStop(0, '#1e3222');
          noriGrad.addColorStop(0.45, '#111d14');
          noriGrad.addColorStop(1, '#080e09');
          ctx.fillStyle = noriGrad;
          ctx.fill();

          // Apply fibrous nori texture
          ctx.save();
          ctx.clip();
          if (noriCanvas) {
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.72;
            ctx.drawImage(noriCanvas, -w * 0.55, -h * 0.65, w * 1.1, h * 1.2);
            ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
          }
          // Warm lantern rim catchlight on upper edge of nori
          const edgeGlow = ctx.createLinearGradient(-w * 0.5, -h * 0.62, w * 0.3, -h * 0.15);
          edgeGlow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(175, 195, 130, ${0.22 + lightX * 0.05})`);
          edgeGlow.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(130, 145, 95, 0.06)');
          edgeGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
          ctx.fillStyle = edgeGlow;
          ctx.fillRect(-w * 0.6, -h * 0.65, w * 1.2, h * 1.2);
          ctx.restore();

          // Crisp highlight on top cut edge
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(155, 175, 120, 0.24)';
          ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, R * 0.005);
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(-w * 0.49, -h * 0.57);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -h * 0.61, w * 0.49, -h * 0.53);
          ctx.stroke();

          ctx.restore();
        }
      }

      // Draw rich golden-amber miso-sesame broth + submerged noodles + ripples
      function drawBrothAndSubmergedNoodles(bx, by, brx, bry, time, lightX, lightY, flicker) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(bx, by, brx, bry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.clip();

        // Deep luminous miso-sesame broth gradient
        const glowX = bx + lightX * brx * 0.18 + Math.sin(time * 0.4) * brx * 0.03;
        const glowY = by - bry * 0.06 + lightY * bry * 0.14;
        const brothGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(glowX, glowY, brx * 0.05, bx, by, brx * 1.04);
        brothGrad.addColorStop(0, '#d88c34');
        brothGrad.addColorStop(0.34, '#b86820');
        brothGrad.addColorStop(0.66, '#7a3b12');
        brothGrad.addColorStop(0.88, '#421d08');
        brothGrad.addColorStop(1, '#240f04');
        ctx.fillStyle = brothGrad;
        ctx.fillRect(bx - brx, by - bry, brx * 2, bry * 2);

        // Subtle convective miso swirl clouds beneath the surface
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
          const ang = time * 0.08 + i * 1.57;
          const sx = bx + Math.cos(ang) * brx * 0.26;
          const sy = by + Math.sin(ang) * bry * 0.22;
          const sg = ctx.createRadialGradient(sx, sy, 0, sx, sy, brx * 0.52);
          sg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(235, 165, 72, ${0.11 * flicker})`);
          sg.addColorStop(0.55, `rgba(185, 102, 34, ${0.04 * flicker})`);
          sg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
          ctx.fillStyle = sg;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(sx, sy, brx * 0.55, bry * 0.45, ang * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }
        ctx.restore();

        // Submerged wavy ramen noodles (visible beneath translucent golden broth)
        for (const s of noodleStrands) {
          if (s.layer !== 0) continue;
          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(bx, by);
          ctx.rotate(s.angle);

          const len = brx * 1.45 * s.len;
          const yBase = s.offset * bry * 0.92;
          const amp = s.amp * brx;
          const lw = s.width * brx;

          ctx.lineCap = 'round';
          ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

          // Soft dark depth shadow under strand
          ctx.beginPath();
          const steps = 22;
          for (let k = 0; k <= steps; k++) {
            const u = k / steps;
            const px = (u - 0.5) * len;
            const wave = Math.sin(u * s.freq + s.phase + time * 0.45) * amp;
            const py = yBase + wave;
            if (k === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
            else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
          }

          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(48, 20, 5, 0.42)';
          ctx.lineWidth = lw * 1.25;
          ctx.stroke();

          // Translucent broth-tinted golden noodle body
          const alpha = 0.28 + s.tone * 0.26;
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(236, 184, 96, ${alpha})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = lw;
          ctx.stroke();

          ctx.restore();
        }

        // Translucent amber broth glaze veil over submerged noodles to create depth
        const veil = ctx.createRadialGradient(bx, by, brx * 0.18, bx, by, brx * 1.02);
        veil.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(185, 100, 28, 0.16)');
        veil.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(105, 48, 12, 0.34)');
        veil.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(28, 11, 3, 0.72)');
        ctx.fillStyle = veil;
        ctx.fillRect(bx - brx, by - bry, brx * 2, bry * 2);

        // Expanding concentric broth ripples
        for (const rip of ripples) {
          const rx = bx + rip.x * brx;
          const ry = by + rip.y * bry;
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 224, 168, ${rip.alpha})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, brx * 0.008);
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(rx, ry, rip.r * brx, rip.r * bry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.stroke();
        }

        // Warm broth sheen reflection reacting subtly to mouse light
        const sheenX = bx + lightX * brx * 0.35 - brx * 0.12;
        const sheenY = by - bry * 0.22 + lightY * bry * 0.25;
        const sheen = ctx.createRadialGradient(sheenX, sheenY, 0, sheenX, sheenY, brx * 0.62);
        sheen.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 232, 188, ${0.14 * flicker})`);
        sheen.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(255, 198, 124, ${0.05 * flicker})`);
        sheen.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 198, 124, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = sheen;
        ctx.fillRect(bx - brx, by - bry, brx * 2, bry * 2);

        // Meniscus highlight right where broth meets dark ceramic wall
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 206, 138, ${0.22 * flicker})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.2, brx * 0.012);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(bx, by, brx * 0.992, bry * 0.992, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();

        ctx.restore();
      }

      // Draw emerging glistening ramen noodle mound in center-lower-right
      function drawEmergingNoodles(bx, by, brx, bry, time, flicker) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(bx + brx * 0.04, by + bry * 0.07);
        ctx.rotate(-0.22);

        // Soft shadow cast into broth beneath noodle mound
        const shGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, bry * 0.05, brx * 0.05, 0, bry * 0.05, brx * 0.44);
        shGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(32, 12, 3, 0.55)');
        shGrad.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(32, 12, 3, 0.18)');
        shGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(32, 12, 3, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = shGrad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, bry * 0.05, brx * 0.44, bry * 0.34, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        const emerging = noodleStrands.filter((s) => s.layer === 1);
        for (const s of emerging) {
          const arcOffset = (s.t - 0.5) * bry * 0.46;
          const span = brx * (0.68 - Math.abs(s.t - 0.5) * 0.36);
          const amp = s.amp * brx;
          const lw = s.width * brx;
          const breathe = Math.sin(time * 0.9 + s.phase) * brx * 0.004;

          ctx.lineCap = 'round';
          ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

          // Build wavy arched strand path
          const buildPath = (yShift) => {
            ctx.beginPath();
            const steps = 20;
            for (let k = 0; k <= steps; k++) {
              const u = k / steps;
              const px = (u - 0.5) * span;
              const arch = -Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * bry * 0.12;
              const wave = Math.sin(u * s.freq + s.phase + time * 0.35) * amp;
              const py = arcOffset + arch + wave + breathe + yShift;
              if (k === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
              else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
            }
          };

          // Crevice shadow
          buildPath(lw * 0.35);
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(72, 34, 8, 0.65)';
          ctx.lineWidth = lw * 1.18;
          ctx.stroke();

          // Warm alkaline wheat noodle body
          buildPath(0);
          const nGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-span * 0.5, arcOffset - lw, span * 0.5, arcOffset + lw);
          nGrad.addColorStop(0, '#c68d3a');
          nGrad.addColorStop(0.35, '#edd086');
          nGrad.addColorStop(0.68, '#e3bc68');
          nGrad.addColorStop(1, '#b87d2e');
          ctx.strokeStyle = nGrad;
          ctx.lineWidth = lw;
          ctx.stroke();

          // Glossy wet broth specular highlight along top ridge of noodle
          buildPath(-lw * 0.24);
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 245, 214, ${(0.32 + s.tone * 0.22) * flicker})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = lw * 0.26;
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // Draw roasted shiitake mushrooms with decorative hanagiri star-cut scoring
      function drawShiitakeMushrooms(bx, by, brx, bry, time, lightX, flicker) {
        const caps = [
          { x: -0.11, y: -0.42, r: 0.21, rot: -0.24, bob: 0.4 },
          { x: 0.16, y: -0.46, r: 0.18, rot: 0.32, bob: 2.1 }
        ];

        for (const cap of caps) {
          const bobY = Math.sin(time * 1.2 + cap.bob) * bry * 0.008;
          const cx = bx + cap.x * brx;
          const cy = by + cap.y * bry + bobY;
          const r = cap.r * brx;

          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(cx, cy);
          ctx.rotate(cap.rot);
          ctx.scale(1, 0.84);

          // Soft shadow on broth
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(22, 8, 2, 0.55)';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(r * 0.06, r * 0.18, r * 1.04, r * 0.96, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();

          // Plump roasted mushroom cap silhouette
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(0, 0, r, r * 0.92, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          const capGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(-r * 0.28 + lightX * r * 0.2, -r * 0.32, r * 0.06, 0, 0, r * 1.05);
          capGrad.addColorStop(0, '#6e452b');
          capGrad.addColorStop(0.4, '#472817');
          capGrad.addColorStop(0.78, '#28150b');
          capGrad.addColorStop(1, '#190c06');
          ctx.fillStyle = capGrad;
          ctx.fill();

          // Subtle pale gill rim peeking at lower underside
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(210, 178, 134, 0.45)';
          ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.07;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(0, r * 0.06, r * 0.94, r * 0.86, 0, 0.35, Math.PI - 0.35);
          ctx.stroke();

          // Decorative hanagiri 3-slash (6-point star) scoring revealing creamy flesh
          for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
            const ang = (k * Math.PI) / 3 + 0.18;
            ctx.save();
            ctx.rotate(ang);

            // Inner groove shadow
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(42, 20, 8, 0.72)';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(-r * 0.58, 0);
            ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -r * 0.13, r * 0.58, 0);
            ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, r * 0.13, -r * 0.58, 0);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();

            // Creamy ivory mushroom flesh exposed by score
            const fleshGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-r * 0.5, -r * 0.08, r * 0.5, r * 0.08);
            fleshGrad.addColorStop(0, '#c89e6e');
            fleshGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#f0d8b2');
            fleshGrad.addColorStop(1, '#b88a58');
            ctx.fillStyle = fleshGrad;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(-r * 0.52, 0);
            ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -r * 0.09, r * 0.52, 0);
            ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, r * 0.09, -r * 0.52, 0);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();

            ctx.restore();
          }

          // Glossy roasted oil specular highlight on cap dome
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 224, 185, ${0.26 * flicker})`;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(-r * 0.34 + lightX * r * 0.12, -r * 0.34, r * 0.24, r * 0.11, -0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();

          ctx.restore();

      function roundRect(c, x, y, w, h, r) {
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(x + r, y);
        c.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
        c.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
        c.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
        c.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
        c.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
        c.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
        c.lineTo(x, y + r);
        c.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
        c.closePath();
      }

      // Draw organic curling steam ribbons & billowing volumetric mist plumes
      function drawSteam(cx, cy, R, time, flicker) {
        ctx.save();

        // Layer 1: Soft curling wispy steam ribbons
        for (const rib of steamRibbons) {
          const baseX = cx + rib.anchorX * R * 0.62;
          const baseY = cy + rib.anchorY * R * 0.45;
          const totalH = R * 1.45 * rib.heightScale;
          const segments = 22;

          ctx.save();
          ctx.lineCap = 'round';
          for (let pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
            const wMult = pass === 0 ? 1.0 : 0.48;
            const aMult = pass === 0 ? 0.55 : 0.85;

            ctx.beginPath();
            for (let i = 0; i <= segments; i++) {
              const t = i / segments;
              const rise = t * totalH;
              const sway =
                Math.sin(t * rib.freq * Math.PI - time * rib.speed + rib.phase) * rib.amp * R * Math.pow(t, 0.72) +
                rib.swayOffset * R * Math.pow(t, 1.15);
              const px = baseX + sway;
              const py = baseY - rise;
              if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
              else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
            }

            const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(baseX, baseY, baseX, baseY - totalH);
            const a = rib.alpha * aMult * flicker;
            grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 212, 162, 0)');
            grad.addColorStop(0.18, `rgba(255, 214, 168, ${a})`);
            grad.addColorStop(0.55, `rgba(242, 228, 214, ${a * 0.75})`);
            grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(232, 224, 218, 0)');

            ctx.strokeStyle = grad;
            ctx.lineWidth = R * rib.widthScale * wMult;
            ctx.stroke();
          }
          ctx.restore();
        }

        // Layer 2: Soft billowing mist puffs (warm backlit near broth, misty ivory above)
        for (const p of steamPuffs) {
          const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p.age / p.maxLife));
          // Smooth fade in and gentle dissolve
          const fadeIn = Math.min(1, t / 0.18);
          const fadeOut = Math.pow(1 - t, 1.45);
          const alpha = fadeIn * fadeOut * 0.44 * flicker;
          if (alpha <= 0.002) continue;

          const px = cx + p.x * R;
          const py = cy + p.y * R;
          const scale = p.size * R * (0.72 + t * 1.45);

          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(px, py);
          ctx.rotate(p.rot);
          // Warm golden-tinted steam close to broth, cooler ivory higher up
          const warmAlpha = alpha * (1 - t) * p.warmth;
          const coolAlpha = alpha * (0.35 + t * 0.65);

          if (warmSteamSprite && warmAlpha > 0.005) {
            ctx.globalAlpha = warmAlpha;
            ctx.drawImage(warmSteamSprite, -scale, -scale * 0.9, scale * 2, scale * 1.8);
          }
          if (steamSprite && coolAlpha > 0.005) {
            ctx.globalAlpha = coolAlpha;
            ctx.drawImage(steamSprite, -scale, -scale * 0.9, scale * 2, scale * 1.8);
          }
          ctx.restore();
        }

        ctx.restore();
      }

        ctx.save();
        for (const m of dustMotes) {
          const mx = (m.x + Math.sin(time * 0.32 + m.driftPhase) * 0.018) * width;

        }
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // =========================================================================
      // SIMULATION STEP
      // =========================================================================
      const simRng = mulberry32(8087);

      function stepSimulation(dt, time) {
        // Smooth pointer parallax & decay velocity
        pointer.sx = lerp(pointer.sx, pointer.nx, Math.min(1, dt * 4.2));
        pointer.sy = lerp(pointer.sy, pointer.ny, Math.min(1, dt * 4.2));
        pointer.vx *= Math.pow(0.06, dt);
        pointer.vy *= Math.pow(0.06, dt);

        // Update ripples
        for (let i = ripples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
          const rip = ripples[i];
          rip.r += dt * 0.34;
          rip.alpha *= Math.pow(0.12, dt);
          if (rip.r >= rip.maxR || rip.alpha < 0.008) {
            ripples.splice(i, 1);
          }
        }

        // Occasional gentle ambient simmer ripple
        if (simRng() < dt * 0.55) {
          const a = simRng() * Math.PI * 2;
          const r = Math.sqrt(simRng()) * 0.55;
          spawnRipple(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r, 0.32);
        }

        // Spring-return & gentle convective drift for floating scallions
        for (const sc of scallions) {
          sc.vx += (sc.bx - sc.x) * 1.8 * dt;
          sc.vy += (sc.by - sc.y) * 1.8 * dt;
          sc.vx *= Math.pow(0.18, dt);
          sc.vy *= Math.pow(0.18, dt);
          sc.x += sc.vx * dt;
          sc.y += sc.vy * dt;
        }

        // Drift & spring-return for oil droplets
        for (const d of oilDroplets) {
          const targetX = d.bx + Math.sin(time * d.driftSpeed + d.driftPhase) * 0.024;
          const targetY = d.by + Math.cos(time * d.driftSpeed * 0.85 + d.driftPhase) * 0.018;
          d.vx += (targetX - d.x) * 1.4 * dt;
          d.vy += (targetY - d.y) * 1.4 * dt;
          d.vx *= Math.pow(0.22, dt);
          d.vy *= Math.pow(0.22, dt);
          d.x += d.vx * dt;
          d.y += d.vy * dt;
        }

        // Interactive pointer influence in steam space (normalized to bowl center & radius)
        const pSteamX = (pointer.x - bowlCx) / Math.max(1, bowlR);
        const pSteamY = (pointer.y - bowlCy) / Math.max(1, bowlR);

        // Update billowing steam puffs
        for (let i = 0; i < steamPuffs.length; i++) {
          const p = steamPuffs[i];
          p.age += dt;
          if (p.age >= p.maxLife) {
            steamPuffs[i] = createSteamPuff(simRng, false);
            continue;
          }

          // Natural upward buoyancy + organic curl
          const curl = Math.sin(time * 0.85 + p.turbulencePhase + p.y * 2.2) * 0.14;
          p.vx += (curl - p.vx) * 1.2 * dt;

          // Mouse stir turbulence
          if (pointer.active) {
            const dx = p.x - pSteamX;
            const dy = p.y - pSteamY;
            const dSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
            if (dSq < 0.85) {
              const inf = Math.exp(-dSq * 2.8);
              p.vx += pointer.vx * inf * 4.5 * dt;
              p.vy += pointer.vy * inf * 2.6 * dt;
            }
          }

          p.x += p.vx * dt;
          p.y += p.vy * dt;
          p.rot += p.rotSpeed * dt;
        }

        // Update steam ribbons with pointer swirl
        for (const rib of steamRibbons) {
          if (pointer.active) {
            const dx = rib.anchorX * 0.62 - pSteamX;
            const dy = -0.65 - pSteamY;
            const dSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
            if (dSq < 1.4) {
              const inf = Math.exp(-dSq * 1.6);
              rib.swayVel += pointer.vx * inf * 2.4 * dt;
            }
          }
          rib.swayVel += (-rib.swayOffset * 2.4) * dt;
          rib.swayVel *= Math.pow(0.14, dt);
          rib.swayOffset += rib.swayVel * dt;
        }

        // Update warm ambient dust motes
        for (const m of dustMotes) {
          m.y += m.speedY * dt;
          if (m.y < -0.04) {
            m.y = 1.04;
            m.x = simRng();
          }
        }
      }

      // =========================================================================
      // MAIN RENDER
      // =========================================================================
      function render(time, dt) {
        // Gentle warm lantern breath / micro-flicker
        const flicker = reducedMotion
          ? 1.0
          : 0.965 + Math.sin(time * 2.1) * 0.02 + noise1D(time * 1.7) * 0.022;

        const px = reducedMotion ? 0 : pointer.sx;
        const py = reducedMotion ? 0 : pointer.sy;

        // Subtle 3D layered parallax offsets
        const cx = bowlCx + px * bowlR * 0.028;
        const cy = bowlCy + py * bowlR * 0.022;
        const innerCx = cx + px * bowlR * 0.016;
        const innerCy = cy + bowlR * 0.045 + py * bowlR * 0.012;
        const brx = bowlR * 0.875;
        const bry = brx * TILT;

        // 1. Dark atmospheric charred wood background & warm lantern glow
        drawBackground(time, px, py, flicker);

        // 2. Grounded contact & ambient bowl shadows
        drawBowlShadow(cx, cy, bowlR, px, py);

        // 3. Artisan stoneware bowl exterior & inner glazed wall
        drawBowlExterior(cx, cy, bowlR, px, py, flicker);

        // 4. Crisp roasted nori sheets tucked against the inner back-left rim
        drawNoriSheets(innerCx, innerCy, bowlR, time, px);

        // 5. Golden-amber miso-sesame broth, submerged wavy noodles, ripples & sheen
        drawBrothAndSubmergedNoodles(innerCx, innerCy, brx, bry, time, px, py, flicker);

        drawOilDroplets(innerCx, innerCy, brx, bry, time, px, flicker);

        drawEmergingNoodles(innerCx, innerCy, brx, bry, time, flicker);

        drawShiitakeMushrooms(innerCx, innerCy, brx, bry, time, px, flicker);

        drawBokChoy(innerCx, innerCy, brx, bry, time, px, flicker);

        drawSearedTofu(innerCx, innerCy, brx, bry, time, px, flicker);

        stepSimulation(dt, elapsed);

- **Natural Motion & Interactivity**: Rising layered volumetric steam (curling wisps + billowing backlit plumes), subtle broth simmer ripples, and gentle floating drift. Moving or clicking the mouse shifts the warm lantern lighting and subtle 3D parallax, swirls the rising steam, sends ripples across the broth, and gently nudges floating scallions and oil droplets.
